column1: # Spanish (es) catalog for ArtCraft Toolbox. Columns, separated by a TAB:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
#   context  empty                a plain UI string; `source` is the English text in the code
#            @plural              `source` is "one|other" (the English forms); the translation lists the
#                                 language's forms separated by "|" (see `plural` in i18n/mod.rs)
#            anything else        a disambiguating context passed to `tr_ctx`
#   escapes  \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns.
#   lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Clean-room: entries are written from the plain meaning of the English text in ordinary computing
# vocabulary, or taken from PhotoCraft's catalog for the same English string (MIT OR Apache-2.0,
# like this project). No proprietary localisation resource was consulted or copied.
# Product names (ArtCraft Toolbox, PhotoCraft, GitHub, macOS ...) stay as they are; the trailing "…"
# of commands that ask before acting is kept.
